observations: Photo 0: A black mirrorless camera with a flip-out touchscreen is held in hand. The screen shows 'No card in camera' and a live view of the shelf behind. The camera has a hot shoe with an attached accessory, possibly a flash or microphone mount. The body has visible wear, especially on the grip and dials. A label on the bottom plate shows CE, FCC, and other regulatory marks, but no brand or model is legible.

Photo 1: Same camera from a slightly different angle, showing the back and bottom. The screen again shows 'No card in camera'. The bottom plate label is visible but still unreadable. The camera appears to be a Sony model based on the shape and button layout, but no text confirms it.

Photo 2: The camera's screen is now showing the date/time setting menu with '2017/01/01 00:00:00' and 'yy/mm/dd' format. The bottom plate label is still not readable. The camera body shows signs of use, including scuffs on the top plate and grip.

All photos show the same camera from different angles. No lens is visible attached to the camera body in any photo, contradicting the seller's claim of 'kit lens'. No battery is visible. The environment appears to be a store or workshop with other cameras and accessories on shelves.

claims.evidence: The screen is on and shows menus and live view, indicating power and basic functionality. However, no photo shows the camera taking a photo, recording video, or showing a full operational sequence. The 'No card in camera' message is expected and does not prove functionality. No proof of lens or battery operation is shown.

claims.claim: The camera comes with the kit lens and 1 battery.
claims.evidence: No lens is visible attached to the camera in any photo. The camera body is shown without a lens. No battery is visible in any photo. The seller's claim is not supported by the visual evidence.

risks.risk: The camera may be damaged or non-functional beyond basic screen display.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, recording video, and showing the image on the screen and in playback.

risks.risk: The camera may be missing the kit lens and battery as claimed.
risks.proof: Photos showing the lens attached to the camera and the battery inserted into the camera or placed next to it.

risks.risk: The camera may be a counterfeit or non-genuine model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name on the camera body or a serial number, or a photo of the original box with model details.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the camera body showing the brand and model name.
Photos showing the kit lens attached to the camera and the battery inserted or placed next to it.
A video showing the camera taking a photo and playing back the image.
A photo of the camera's original box or packaging, if available.
response.reason: The camera's brand and model cannot be identified from the photos, and the seller's claims about included accessories are contradicted by the visual evidence. Functionality is unverified. Without proof of model, accessories, and full operation, a price cannot be determined. The item must be verified before pricing.
